v0.1.2.description: Apparently I forgot to include the actual correctly built files the last build. Fixed.

v0.2.0.description:
New yaml options:
Artifact locations can now be exact (must find Angrist to send Angrist) or accumulated (must send X artifacts for next check).
There is now a "Trait" mode- artifacts are removed from the game, and your hero is forced to wield an Archipelago Blade that will slowly gain traits.
All artifacts were logically moved one region lower in the dungeon so you wouldn't be expected to get all the 1-20 artifacts while still in 1-20. Accumulated artifact counter is scaling- Only a % of the artifacts are expected to be found on each region, increasing as you go deeper. Accumulated is recommended.
Black market cost multiplier is now configurable.

Balancing is still heavily in progress, but this should be an improvement.
